en-US.name: Echo Chamber Breaker
en-US.summary: The anti-sycophant intellectual honesty coach for Alexa+
en-US.description: Echo Chamber Breaker challenges your strong opinions with high-quality steelmanned opposing arguments, measures whether you engage honestly, and tracks your private Intellectual Honesty Score.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Echo Chamber Breaker to challenge my opinion on remote work
Alexa, ask Echo Chamber Breaker what is my honesty score

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Open the skill and state an opinion, or ask for your honesty score.
